scope: Read-only source/method alignment for a small-model development adaptation; no GPU experiment was run by this audit.

paper.title: Grokked Transformers are Implicit Reasoners: A Mechanistic Journey to the Edge of Generalization

world.relation_selection: per head, distinct relations sampled without replacement
world.tail_selection: uniform random entity independently per (head,relation); self-loops and repeated tail values allowed
world.atomic_split: uniform global edge partition: 95% ID, 5% OOD; all atomic facts included in training

paths.ID: both edges in ID atomic partition
paths.OOD: both edges in OOD atomic partition
paths.mixed_ID_OOD: excluded from compositional training and the reported ID/OOD composition probes
paths.ID_test_reservation: each ID path independently reserved with probability 0.005 before training subsampling
paths.training: uniform subset without replacement from remaining ID paths; count round(phi * ID atomic count)
paths.train_examples: all ID+OOD atomic facts concatenated with sampled ID compositions; random permutation each epoch, no separate balanced task sampler
paths.probe_sizes: up to 3000 per split; original valid.json contains OOD compositions

serialization.notes: <q>, </q>, <a>, <sep>, <mask> exist in added vocabulary but are not used by composition form_items
serialization.tokenizer: GPT2 tokenizer with all E entities, R relations and six markers added as single tokens; original 50257-token vocabulary retained
serialization.pad: original GPT2 <|endoftext|>, different from newly added answer end marker
serialization.loss: causal cross-entropy on tail and only, equally weighted token losses; input-prefix labels and right-padding labels masked -100
serialization.evaluation: greedy generation; compare serialized answer up to ; first entity-token argmax is a close but explicitly different simplified metric

model.architecture: standard causal decoder-only GPT2, pre-LN, train from random initialization
model.positional_embedding: learned absolute, GPT2 default max positions 1024
model.residual_output_init_std: 0.02 / sqrt(2 * n_layer) for attention and MLP c_proj weights

optimization.weight_decay_exclusions: parameter names containing bias, LayerNorm.weight, or ln; embeddings are decayed

paper_code_distinctions: Paper describes prediction of final tail. Code supervises both tail and answer-ending marker, while masking every prefix token.
Paper does not enumerate dropout. README does not enable --no_dropout; GPT2 defaults imply 0.1 embedding, attention and residual dropout.
CLI defaults (LR 4e-5, WD 0.01, linear scheduler, batch16, epochs20) do not reproduce the paper. README command overrides most; weight decay must be supplied externally as 0.1.
Original tokenizer retains 50257 base tokens even though the factual task uses the newly added tokens; compact vocabulary is an explicit adaptation.
Paper conceptual ID test is unseen inferred facts. Notebook reserves 0.5% ID paths, then samples training from the remaining pool; unused training-pool paths are not added to test probes.
Notebook has no explicit random seed and iterates sets when serializing facts. Independent deterministic generation should record the world seed and partition seed.
Main paper uses 8-layer width768 models. A 1/2-layer width64/128 model is a new controlled small-scale adaptation, not an exact reproduction.
Paper says two million updates were also tried for OOD; README default maximum is 1.5 million.

planned_small_adaptation_from_parent.status: planned development configuration; record actual executed config separately
retain: both ID/OOD atomic facts in training

scientific_cautions: For E128, degree8 and a 5% OOD edge split, expected both-OOD path count is only about 20. OOD estimates are descriptive and must show denominator.

With 10% ID path reservation, degree8 and phi6, about 88% of available training-pool ID paths are used. Successful calibration may show direct generalization rather than delayed grokking. A later lower-phi comparison is needed to investigate delay.
Reducing relation vocabulary from 200 to 16 and degree20 to 8 changes reuse statistics, path availability and the achievable inferred/atomic ratio; this is more than changing model size.
A one-layer model failing within budget does not establish an architectural impossibility. Verify atomic and training-composition prerequisites and report right-censored threshold times.

Compare learning curves against updates, example exposure and estimated computation. Extra layers increase per-step computation and parameters; a matched-parameter one-layer follow-up is useful only after a working deeper model exists.
Do not infer one-hop-per-layer solely from successful two-layer behavior; that mechanism requires additional evidence.
A compact vocabulary changes the output softmax and tied-embedding capacity. Report this adaptation and do not use unchanged absolute step counts as an exact paper replication.
Keep PAD distinct from trained EOS or mask pads by position; ID-based masking with PAD=EOS would erase the ending-marker training signal.
Do not mix OOD or held-out development performance into an undisclosed checkpoint-selection rule. The pilot is calibration; independent worlds are needed for later confirmation.
For a small world, accidental equalities (tail=head or tail=bridge) occur more often. Keep whole-set scores and predeclare any descriptive subsets rather than deleting easy cases after results.
